summary: Implemented Graph.cbd(resource) in rdflib/graph.py (last method of Graph, before ConjunctiveGraph) with the spec docstring and a nested add_to_cbd helper covering the three CBD rules, including rdf:subject reification with no type or predicate/object matching. Added test/test_graph_cbd.py with CbdTestCase (setUp/tearDown, Turtle fixture, main guard) covering rule 1/2 counts, typed and untyped reifiers, incoming reification, blank-node reifier objects, blank-node cycles, and source immutability. Nothing was run, per the instructions, so the tests are unverified. Two things to check: the fixture is my own (the spec's fixture was not provided), and the code relies on parse(data=..., format='turtle') and wildcard Graph.__contains__, which should be confirmed against the pinned rdflib version. No commits were made.
